metadata.description: Spouse of Imin, the first Elf-father. She was awakened by Imin at Cuiviénen during the Years of the Trees. Together with Imin and the 6 other couples they awakened, they became the Minyar ('Firsts') – the smallest clan with 14 members. Her descendants became the Vanyar, the 'Fair-elves' known for their golden hair. She is the ancestress of Ingwë, High King of all Elves.
